questions.question: In your Interim Accountant role at Surescripts, how did you use QuickBooks to support accounting functions, Accounts Payable, check preparation, and petty cash administration?
Describe your experience with Accounts Payable and invoice processing. What steps did you take to ensure payments and supporting documentation were accurate?
This role requires monthly balance-sheet reconciliations. Can you walk me through how you would reconcile an account, investigate discrepancies, and document the resolution?
What exposure have you had to month-end close activities, such as preparing journal entries, accruals, allocations, or account reconciliations?
How would you approach maintaining a prepaid expense schedule and preparing monthly amortization entries?
Have you worked with budgets, project P&Ls, or financial tracking for client programs? Please describe the reports you prepared and how you used them to monitor performance.
You have analyzed monthly revenue reports and prepared weekly, monthly, and quarterly partner reports. How did you validate the underlying data and communicate significant variances?
This position prepares financial reporting packages and flux analysis. How would you identify and explain a material month-over-month variance to management?
Describe your Microsoft Excel skills and provide examples of the formulas, functions, pivot tables, or reporting tools you have used to analyze financial or operational data.

The role requires applying US GAAP, including lease accounting. What familiarity do you have with accounting principles, and how would you research an unfamiliar accounting issue such as a lease classification or rent-related accrual?
